title: Fixed-Population Causal Inference for Models of Equilibrium
abstract: arXiv:2501.19394v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In contrast to problems of interference in (exogenous) treatments, models of interference in unit-specific (endogenous) outcomes do not usually produce a reduced-form representation where outcomes depend on other units' treatment status only at a short network distance, or only through a known exposure mapping. This remains true if the structural mechanism depends on outcomes of peers only at a short network distance, or through a known exposure mapping. In this paper, we first define causal estimands that are identified and estimable from a single experiment on the network under minimal assumptions on the structure of interference, and which represent average partial causal responses which generally vary with other global features of the realized assignment. Under a fixed-population, design-based approach, we show unbiasedness and consistency for inverse-probability weighting (IPW) estimators for those causal parameters from a rando

translated_title: 均衡模型的固定总体因果推断
translated_abstract: 与（外生）处理中的干扰问题不同，单元特定（内生）结果的干扰模型通常无法产生一种简化式表示，即结果仅依赖于短网络距离内其他单元的处理状态，或仅通过已知的暴露映射依赖于其他单元的处理状态。即使结构机制仅依赖于短网络距离内同伴的结果，或通过已知暴露映射依赖于同伴的结果，这种情况依然成立。在本文中，我们首先定义了一类因果估计对象，它们在对干扰结构的最少假设下，可通过网络上的单一实验进行识别和估计，这些估计对象代表平均部分因果响应，且这些响应通常会随实现分配的其他全局特征而变化。在固定总体、基于设计的方法框架下，我们证明了针对这些因果参数的逆概率加权（IPW）估计量在随机实验中具有无偏性和一致性……
tldr: 本文针对内生均衡干扰模型，在对干扰结构最少假设的条件下定义了可通过单一网络实验识别和估计的因果估计对象，并证明了其逆概率加权估计量在固定总体、基于设计的框架下具有无偏性和一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper defines causal estimands for models of equilibrium with endogenous interference that are identified and estimable from a single network experiment under minimal assumptions on the interference structure, and establishes unbiasedness and consistency of IPW estimators under a fixed-population, design-based approach.
